wylie: zas skom gyi sgrib pa can la yi dvags me lce'i phreng ba zhes bya ba ni zos so cog dang 'thungs so cog gis tshig pa ste bkres skom yang zhi bar mi 'gyur ba'o
english: Next are the craving spirits with obstacles to what they can eat or drink. An example would be the spirit whose name was "The Necklace of Flame." Every single thing this spirit tried to eat, and every single thing it tried to drink as well, would burn it instead; and whatever went down would anyway never relieve those feelings of hunger and thirst.
